conbody.p: When driving in SPORT mode, the driver’s seat bolster tightens to provide additional support to the driver’s waist, which helps improve stability during sporty driving.

li.p: Select SettingsVehicleSeatsSmart posture care from the infotainment system.
When SPORT mode is selected in the Drive Mode
The cushion support position returns to the vehicle’s initial setting position.
The seat bolster is tightened further when the vehicle’s speed is approximately 130 km/h (80 mph) or higher.
If both conditions below are satisfied, the seat bolster and cushion support position returns to the previous state.
When the Drive Mode other than SPORT mode is selected
When the vehicle’s speed is below approximately 110 km/h (70 mph).
